effect_entries.effect: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.
effect_entries.short_effect: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text:
じぶんの　すべての
のうりょくが　あがるが　こうたい　したり
にげることが　できなくなる。

자신의 모든 능력이
올라가지만 교체하거나
도망칠 수 없게 된다.

提高自己所有的能力，
但無法進行替換或逃走。

Le lanceur voit toutes ses stats augmenter,
mais en contrepartie, il ne peut plus fuir
ou se retirer du combat.

Alle Statuswerte des Anwenders werden erhöht,
aber dafür kann er weder ausgewechselt werden
noch fliehen.

El usuario aumenta todas sus características, pero ya no
puede huir ni ser cambiado por otro.

Chi la usa aumenta tutte le sue statistiche ma non
può più fuggire o essere sostituito.

This move raises all the user’s stats but prevents
the user from switching out or fleeing.
